objective: A frozen exploratory census, exact: every rotation system of a loop of n rings plus one band of n rings joined by single rungs (n = 3 to 8) or by double rungs (n = 3 and 4); which are balanced, with their genus, face sizes and whether a flip fixes every contact.
status: Supported 2026-11-08 (exploratory, exact; H1 and H2 hold): of 1,813,632 rotation systems of a loop plus one band, the balanced ones lie on the sphere only for single rungs on a loop of 4 rings (the cube); with double rungs the n x 2 torus is among them; most balanced first bands lie on surfaces of genus 2 to 4 with no flip at every contact.
title: A census of first bands
